40009116.author: पदार्थः
40009116.content: ततः then, कृत्यवान्  who has done his duty, हनुमान् Hanuman, इति thus, तद्वचः his words, श्रुत्वा having heard, मधुरसम्भाषं च and sweet talk, प्रहृष्टः glad, मनसा at heart, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, गतः about

40009116.author: Translation
40009116.content: After listening to the sweet words of Lakshmana, Hanuman, having done what he had to do felt happy and thought of Sugriva.

40009117.author: पदार्थः
40009117.content: महात्मनः great self, तस्य सुग्रीवस्य that Sugriva's, राज्यागमः acquisition of kingdom, भव्यः is likely to happen, यत् since, कृत्यवान्  one who has done his duty, अयम् this, प्राप्तः got, एतत् this, कृतं च and has work, उपागतम् has come

40009117.author: Translation
40009117.content: The great Sugriva, thinks Hanuman, who had done his duty is likely to acquire his kingdom, because great Rama who would help in the work of Sugriva has also come.'

40009118.author: पदार्थः
40009118.content: ततः then, परमसंहृष्टः extremely happy, प्लवगोत्तमः best of monkeys, हनुमान् Hanuman, ततः then,वाक्यविशारदम् learned in converasation, रामम् Rama's, वाक्यम् words, प्रत्युवाच  enquired

40009118.author: Translation
40009118.content: Hanuman, the best of the monkeys, learned in conversation, felt extremely happy and enquired from Rama:

40009119.author: पदार्थः
40009119.content: सानुजः accompanied by your brother, पम्पाकाननमण्डितम् woods surrounding Pampa, दुर्गम् inaccessible, नानाव्यालमृगायुतम् full of different kinds of serpents and wild animals, घोरम् dreadful, वनम् forest, किमर्थम् why, आगतः came here?

40009119.author: Translation
40009119.content: 'Why have you come with your brother to this dreadful, inaccessible forest surrounding Pampa, full of different varieties of serpents and wild animals?'

40009120.author: पदार्थः
40009120.content: लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, तस्य his, तत् those, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, रामचोदितः urged by Rama, महात्मानम् great soul, दशरथात्मजम् son of Dasaratha, रामम् Rama, आचचक्षे narrated

40009120.author: Translation
40009120.content: Having listened to Hanuman, and urged by Rama, Lakshmana told him about the great Rama, son of Dasaratha.

40009121.author: पदार्थः
40009121.content: द्युतिमान् brilliant, धर्मवत्सलः lover of dharma, चातुर्वर्ण्यम् four classes, नित्यमेव always, स्वधर्मेण  his duty, अभ्यपालयत् ruled, दशरथो नाम named Dasaratha, राजा king

40009121.author: Translation
40009121.content: There was a brilliant king named Dasaratha, a lover of dharma, who ever ruled the four classes righteously according to their own duties.

40009122.author: पदार्थः
40009122.content: तस्य his, द्वेष्टा enemy, न विद्यते never existed, सः he, कञ्चन any one indeed, न द्वेष्टि not hated, सः he, सर्वेषु at all, भूतेषु beings, अपरः another, पितामहः इव like the father, आप्तदक्षिणैः with generous gifts, अग्निष्टोमादिभिः with fire sacrifices and others, यज्ञैः with yajnas, इष्टवान् performed.

40009122.author: Translation
40009122.content: 'He never hated any one nor did any one ever hate him. To all his subjects, he was like another father, the Creator Brahma. And he was generous in giving gifts while performing yajnas (rituals with fire) like Agnistoma.

40009123.author: पदार्थः
40009123.content: अयम् this is, तस्य his, पूर्वजः elder, पुत्रः son, रामो नाम by name Rama, जनैः by people, श्रुतः popular, सर्वभूतानाम् at all beings, शरण्यः protector, पितुः father's, निर्देशपारगः one who  never fails to follow instructions.

40009123.author: Translation
40009123.content: 'Here is his eldest son, popularly known as Rama. He is the protector of all beings and never failed his father's instructions.

40009124.author: पदार्थः
40009124.content: दशरथस्य Dasaratha's, पुत्राणाम् among sons, वीरः warrior, गुणवत्तमः most virtuous, राजलक्षणसंयुक्तः endowed with royal traits, राज्यसम्पदा with royal wealth, संयुक्तः he is endowed with, अयम् this one, राज्यात् from kingdom, भ्रष्टः is sent away, वने in the forest, वस्तुम् to reside, मया सार्धम् along with me, इह here, आगतः has come

40009124.author: Translation
40009124.content: This warrior, the most virtuous among Dasaratha's sons, endowed with royal marks and royal fortune, has been driven from the kingdom and has come here with me to dwell in the forest.

40009125.author: पदार्थः
40009125.content: दशरथस्य Dasaratha's, पुत्राणाम् among sons, वीरः warrior, गुणवत्तमः most virtuous, राजलक्षणसंयुक्तः endowed with royal traits, राज्यसम्पदा with royal wealth, संयुक्तः he is endowed with, अयम् this one, राज्यात् from kingdom, भ्रष्टः is sent away, वने in the forest, वस्तुम् to reside, मया सार्धम् along with me, इह here, आगतः has come

40009125.author: Translation
40009125.content: This warrior, the most virtuous among Dasaratha's sons, endowed with royal marks and royal fortune, has been driven from the kingdom and has come here with me to dwell in the forest.

40009126.author: पदार्थः
40009126.content: महातेजाः glorious one, वशी selfcontrolled, दिनक्षये at the end of the day, दिवाकरः Sun, प्रभयेव with radiance, भार्यया  with wife, सीतया with Sita, अनुगतः followed

40009126.author: Translation
40009126.content: 'This glorious Rama was followed by his wife, Sita, like the rays of the effulgent Sun follow him to the end of the day.

40009127.author: पदार्थः
40009127.content: अहम् I am, कृतज्ञस्य of the grateful man, बहुज्ञस्य of a wellversed man, अस्य his, गुणैः by virtues, दास्यम् servitude, उपागतः has accepted, अवरः younger, भ्राता brother, नामतः  name, लक्ष्मणो नाम called Lakshmana

40009127.author: Translation
40009127.content: 'I am his younger brother, called Lakshmana. I have accepted the service of this learned, virtuous and grateful man.

40009128.author: पदार्थः
40009128.content: सुखार्हस्य  deserved comforts, महार्हस्य worthy  of reverence, सर्वभूतहितात्मनः wellwisher of all beings, ऐश्वर्येण by wealth, विहीनस्य deprived, वनवासे dwelling in the forest, रतस्य of a man engaged, भार्या wife, रहिते when we were not present2 2सा she, कामरूपिणा who can assume any form at will, रक्षसा by a demon, अपहृता kidnapped, येन वा or by whomsoever,  अस्य his, भार्या wife, हृता has been stolen, तत् that, रक्षः rakshasa, न ज्ञायते is not known

40009128.author: Translation
40009128.content: 'This man who should have lived in comfort and in reverence, one who was worthy of all the wellwishers lost his wealth and was banished into the forest. He is now deprived of his wife kidnapped by an unknown demon who could assume any form at will.

40009129.author: पदार्थः
40009129.content: सुखार्हस्य  deserved comforts, महार्हस्य worthy  of reverence, सर्वभूतहितात्मनः wellwisher of all beings, ऐश्वर्येण by wealth, विहीनस्य deprived, वनवासे dwelling in the forest, रतस्य of a man engaged, भार्या wife, रहिते when we were not present2 2सा she, कामरूपिणा who can assume any form at will, रक्षसा by a demon, अपहृता kidnapped, येन वा or by whomsoever,  अस्य his, भार्या wife, हृता has been stolen, तत् that, रक्षः rakshasa, न ज्ञायते is not known

40009129.author: Translation
40009129.content: 'This man who should have lived in comfort and in reverence, one who was worthy of all the wellwishers lost his wealth and was banished into the forest. He is now deprived of his wife kidnapped by an unknown demon who could assume any form at will.

40009130.author: पदार्थः
40009130.content: दितेः Diti's, पुत्रः a son, शापात् by curse, राक्षसताम् as a demon, गतः became, दनुः नाम called Danu, तेन by him, वानरर्षभः the bull among monkeys, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, समर्थः capable, आख्यातः had said

40009130.author: Translation
40009130.content: 'Diti's son called Danu who had been cursed to live the life of a demon had said that Sugriva, the best among monkeys, would be able to locate her.

40009131.author: पदार्थः
40009131.content: महावीर्यः valiant one, सः he, तव your, भार्यापहारिणम्  who has stolen your wife, ज्ञास्यति will know, दनुः Danu, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having said, भ्राजमानः glowing away, स्वर्गम् heaven, सुखम् happily, गतः went

40009131.author: Translation
40009131.content: 'That Valiant Sugriva can spot the demon who has abducted your wife', said Danu and disappeared happily into heaven shining in brilliance.

40009132.author: पदार्थः
40009132.content: पृच्छतः since you asked, ते you, एतत् that, सर्वम् every event, यथा तथ्येन  in fact, आख्यातम् said, अहं चैव and I also, रामश्च Rama too, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva's, शरणम् refuge, गतौ both arrived

40009132.author: Translation
40009132.content: 'I have given a factual account of everything, since you asked me. Now Rama and I have arrived seeking Sugriva's shelter.

40009133.author: पदार्थः
40009133.content: एषः this person, वित्तानि wealth, दत्त्वा च and gifting , अनुत्तमम् excellence ,यशः fame, प्राप्य च having obtained, पुरा earlier, लोकनाथः lord of the world, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, नाथम् king, इच्छति wishes

40009133.author: Translation
40009133.content: 'Having earned supreme fame through his munificence in the past, this lord of the world now craves Sugriva's indulgence.

40009134.author: पदार्थः
40009134.content: पुरा earlier, यस्य whose, धर्मवत्सलः lover of dharma, पिता father, शरण्यः refuge to others, आसीत् he was, शरण्यश्च refuge of, तस्य his, पुत्रः son, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, शरणं गतः seeks protection

40009134.author: Translation
40009134.content: 'One whose father was once a protector of dharma, a refuge to all now seeks Sugriva's shelter.

40009135.author: पदार्थः
40009135.content: धर्मात्मा righteous, शरण्यः  protector, पुरा earlier, सर्वलोकस्य for the whole world, to all (his) people शरणम् protector, गुरुः respectable, सः he, अयम् this person, राघवः Rama, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva's, शरणं गतः sought protection

40009135.author: Translation
40009135.content: 'This righteous Rama who used to lend in the past protection to the whole world and, indeed, a refuge to all, venerable sir, now seeks Sugriva's shelter.

40009136.author: पदार्थः
40009136.content: यस्य whose, प्रसादे grace, इमाः these, प्रजाः people, सततम् always, प्रसीदेयुः they will be pleased, सः रामः that Rama, वानरेन्द्रस्य chief of monkeys', प्रसादम् favour, अभिकाङ्क्षते is desiring

40009136.author: Translation
40009136.content: 'This Rama for whose grace the subjects were ever bobolden to him now seeks the favour of the Chief of monkeys.

40009137.author: पदार्थः
40009137.content: राज्ञा by the king, येन by whom, दशरथेन by Dasaratha, पृथिव्याम् on this earth, सर्वगुणोपेताः endowed with all virtues, सर्वपार्थिवाः all kings, सदा always, सततम् ever, मानिताः honoured, तस्य his, पूर्वजः eldest, पुत्रः son, त्रिषु लोकेषु in the three worlds, विश्रुतः very famous, अयं रामः such Rama,  वानरेन्द्रम् lord of monkeys, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, शरणमागतः sought refuge

40009137.author: Translation
40009137.content: 'Famous in all the three worlds, this Rama, who was the firshborn of Dasaratha, endowed with all virtues and ever respected by all the kings of this earth, now seeks shelter of Sugriva, Chief of monkeys.

40009138.author: पदार्थः
40009138.content: राज्ञा by the king, येन by whom, दशरथेन by Dasaratha, पृथिव्याम् on this earth, सर्वगुणोपेताः endowed with all virtues, सर्वपार्थिवाः all kings, सदा always, सततम् ever, मानिताः honoured, तस्य his, पूर्वजः eldest, पुत्रः son, त्रिषु लोकेषु in the three worlds, विश्रुतः very famous, अयं रामः such Rama,  वानरेन्द्रम् lord of monkeys, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, शरणमागतः sought refuge

40009138.author: Translation
40009138.content: 'Famous in all the three worlds, this Rama, who was the firshborn of Dasaratha, endowed with all virtues and ever respected by all the kings of this earth, now seeks shelter of Sugriva, Chief of monkeys.

40009139.author: पदार्थः
40009139.content: हरियूधप: lord of monkeys, शोकाभिभूते one who is overcome by grief, शोकार्ते one who is pained  by sorrow, शरणं गते when he sought refuge, रामे to Rama, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, प्रसादम्  favour कर्तुम् to render, अर्हति deserves

40009139.author: Translation
40009139.content: 'Sugriva, lord of monkeys, ought to help Rama who tormented by, and overwhelmed with, grief seeks his favour.'

40009140.author: पदार्थः
40009140.content: करुणम् piteously, साश्रुलोचनम् eyes filled with tears, एवम् that way, ब्रुवाणम् while speaking, सौमित्रिम् to Saumithri, वाक्यविशारदः an erudite speaker, हनुमान् Hanuman, इदम् these, वाक्यम् words, प्रत्युवाच replied back

40009140.author: Translation
40009140.content: To Saumitri who was speaking thus in a piteous tone, his eyes filled with tears the eloquent Hanuman replied:

40009141.author: पदार्थः
40009141.content: बुद्धिसम्पन्नाः highly intelligent, जितक्रोधाः who have conquered anger, जितेन्द्रियाः who have 2 2conquered senses, दिष्ट्या luckily, दर्शनम् to see, आगताः came here, ईदृशाः such men, वानरेन्द्रेण by king of vanaras, द्रष्टव्या deserve to be approached

40009141.author: Translation
40009141.content: 'It is a matter of great fortune that you who have intelligence, control over your senses and conquered anger have come to see the lord of monkeys who needs instead, to approach you.

40009142.author: पदार्थः
40009142.content: वालिना by Vali, कृतवैरः developed enmity, भ्रात्रा by his brother, हृतदारः deprived of his wife, भृशम् strongly, विनिकृतः is offended, राज्यात् from the kingdom, विभ्रष्टः thrown out, सः he, त्यक्त: is abandoned, वने in the forest

40009142.author: Translation
40009142.content: '(In fact) seriously offended by his brother Vali who treated him like his enemy and expelled him from the kingdom. He is now abandoned in the forest, his wife hijacked.

40009143.author: पदार्थः
40009143.content: भास्करात्मजः son of the Sungod, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, अस्माभिः सह along with us, सीतायाः Sita's, परिमार्गणे in search of, युवयोः for both of you, साहाय्यम् help, करिष्यति he will do

40009143.author: Translation
40009143.content: 'Sugriva, son of the Sungod, along with us will extend all help to you, in your search for Sita.'

40009144.author: पदार्थः
40009144.content: हनुमान् Hanuman, मधुरया sweetly, गिरा with words, इत्येवम् like that, श्लक्ष्णम् gently, उक्त्वा having said, साधु well done, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, अभिगच्छेम we will go, इति thus, राघवम् Raghava, बभाषे spoke

40009144.author: Translation
40009144.content: Hanuman, having spoken with sweet, gentle words said to the Raghavas, 'We will now go to Sugriva'.

40009145.author: पदार्थः
40009145.content: धर्मात्मा righteous, सः लक्ष्मणः that Lakshmana, एवम् in that way, ब्रुवाणम् as he spoke, हनुमन्तम् to Hanuman, यथान्यायम् as per tradition, प्रतिपूज्य  offered salutation, राघवम् Raghava, इदम् this, प्रोवाच spoke

40009145.author: Translation
40009145.content: Having offered reverential salutations to Hanuman as per tradition, righteous Lakshmana now spoke to Rama:

40009146.author: पदार्थः
40009146.content: राघव Rama, मारुतात्मजः son of the windgod, अयं कपिः this monkey, हृष्टः a pleased one, यथा as, कथयते he is telling, सोऽपि he also, कृत्यवान् a person of action, सम्प्राप्तः has come, कृतकृत्यः  accomplished, असि you are

40009146.author: Translation
40009146.content: 'O Raghava this monkey, son of the Windgod appears pleased as evident from his words. As he is a man of action, take your work as accomplished now.

40009147.author: पदार्थः
40009147.content: व्यक्तम् it is evident, प्रसन्नमुखवर्णश्च he has a cheerful face, हृष्टश्च he is pleased, भाषते  words, मारुतात्मजः son of the windgod, हनुमान् Hanuman, अनृतम् lie, न वक्ष्यते will not tell

40009147.author: Translation
40009147.content: 'It is evident from his words  and from his cheerful face that Hanuman is pleased. (I know that) this heroic son of the Windgod will never tell a lie'.

40009148.author: पदार्थः
40009148.content: ततः then, महाप्राज्ञः very wise, मारुतात्मजः son of the windgod, सः हनुमान् that Hanuman, वीरौ   warrior heroes, तौ राघवौ both Raghavas, हरिराजाय to the king of monkeys, आदाय led them, जगाम went

40009148.author: Translation
40009148.content: Hanuman, son of the Windgod, endowed with great wisdom carried both the Raghava warriors to the king of monkeys.

40009149.author: पदार्थः
40009149.content: कपिकुञ्जरः elephantlike monkey, भिक्षुरूपम् form of a mendicant, परित्यज्य  gave up, वानरम् monkeys, रूपम् form, आस्थितः assumed, तौ both, वीरौ heroes, पृष्ठम् on the back, आरोप्य lifted, जगाम proceeded.

40009149.author: Translation
40009149.content: Hanuman, who was an elephant among monkeys, gave up the guise of a mendicant, and assuming the form of the monkeys, lifted both the heroes  on to his back and proceeded.

40009150.author: पदार्थः
40009150.content: विपुलयशाः highly renowned, कपिप्रवीरः most heroic monkey, सः पवनसुतः son of the windgod, कृतकृत्यवत् having done his duty, प्रहृष्टः gladly, शुभमतिः with auspicious feeling, उरुविक्रमः renowned for his valiance, सः he, रामलक्ष्मणाभ्यां सह with Rama and Lakshmana, गिरिवरम् to the great mountain, प्रयातः departed.

40009150.author: Translation
40009150.content: The son of the Windgod, the most valiant, the supremely heroic monkey and the one welladmired, having performed his task, felt immensely happy.And with an auspicious feeling, departed for the great mountain (Rishyamuka) along with Rama and Lakshmana. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किंधाकाण्डे चतुर्थस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fourth sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
